risks.title: Karst collapse
risks.mitigation: Confirm karst constraints before drilling; plan casing, controlled flushing, grouting, and abandonment criteria for voids or unstable returns.

risks.title: Artesian or high groundwater flow
risks.mitigation: Prepare groundwater control, containment, packer testing, and discharge management before mobilisation.

risks.title: Shallow bedrock
risks.mitigation: Check shallow obstruction and casing requirements during site investigation and method statement review.

risks.title: Fault or fracture pathway
risks.mitigation: Avoid placing boreholes directly on interpreted pathway corridors where practical; confirm with GI and drilling observations.

risks.title: Buried services conflict
risks.mitigation: Complete utility searches, CAT scan, and GPR/services survey before final collar locations are issued.

risks.title: Sparse direct site data
evidence: limited direct subsurface control at SRSC
risks.mitigation: Use the prognosis as screening only until confirmed by trial holes, GI logs, and thermal response testing.

risks.title: Model edge effects
risks.mitigation: Flag low-confidence model-boundary or sparse-control zones and avoid over-reading precise contacts near edges.

risks.title: Regulatory and ecology screening
risks.mitigation: Complete Appropriate Assessment screening and permitting review where works, discharge, or protected sites may be affected.
